messages:
nina: Heads-up — quick canary notes: routed 10% traffic to q4b-int4-v2 and saw a regression on the long-summary evals (rouge-l down ~6pts, hallucination rate up ~9pp) on contexts >2k tokens. Dropping a tiny repro set + a couple examples. @sam @diego please weigh in.

sam: Yikes. What exact eval command and model tag? Also which kernel was used on the canary nodes?

nina: Command I ran: ```python
run_eval(model='q4b-int4-v2', suite='long_summ_v2', batch_size=8, max_tokens=4096)
```
Tag: q4b-int4-v2. Canary uses int4 kernel v3.2 (new packing). Metrics exported to s3://redwood-evals/q4b_v2_long_summ/metrics.json (snippet attached).

diego: No tokenizer or postproc changes? If not, kernel packing or KV packing are suspects. I can try a build with older packing and rerun.

nina: Tokenizer unchanged. I uploaded N=50 failing long-context prompts to /mnt/curation/q4b_longctx_regression.json (redacted). Pasting 3 representative failures here: 1) codebase summary that invents a nonexistent helper API; 2) multi-turn spec chat that fabricates a past decision; 3) 3.2k meeting notes where it asserts facts not present.

elaine: Ill spin up a golden refresh: add these 50 failing items + 200 fuzz/paraphrase borderlines from the seedbank, run dedupe + provenance checks, and push a labeling batch. Also propose adding a label field "hallucinated_fact_span" and a severity enum (low/med/high).

mike: If customers can hit this, rollback now. Prefer to be cautious.

rachel: Short mitigation: create routing rule to send requests with context_length>2048 to baseline fp16 model. I can add the rule in Console and update support. That should reduce exposure while we investigate.

sam: For root cause: run the same model weights as fp16 (disable quant) and compare outputs. If fp16 looks OK, quant kernel is likely the culprit. I'll open a quant-bisect ticket and attach eval diffs + kernel traces.

diego: Ill run a side-by-side: v3.1 packing vs v3.2 packing on the N=50 set and collect token-level logits + KV cache traces. If tiling/packing changed alignment, that could explain hallucination spikes for long contexts.

lab-bot: Assigned 250 items to @labeler-team for golden review; priority: P0; due: 36h. :clipboard:

mike: +1 on rollback. Also we should throttle canary traffic while we wait for bisect results.

nina: Proposed immediate plan: 1) rollback canary to q4b-int4-v1 (now) and throttle to 0% until we confirm fixes; 2) golden refresh batch (50 + 200) assigned to labeling; 3) run fp16 vs int4 bisect and v3.1 vs v3.2 kernel comparison; 4) re-eval and re-canary in ~48h.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: revert/canary/q4b-int4-v1 — triggered by nina.

rachel: Ill implement the >2048 routing rule and notify support docs + status page.

sam: Ill own the bisect ticket and link the kernel perf traces, eval diffs, and sample outputs. Diego owns kernel experiments. Elaine owns golden + label schema. Nina will coordinate final go/no-go.

nina: Thanks all. Marking this P0 and leaving the N=50 sample set in the shared curation folder. Ping here if label capacity is tight or you need more context. :eyes:
